resolutionSnapshotSource: context — read from the evaluation Attempt's injected EvaluationContext (resolutionSnapshot, market, window, consensusProbabilityYes); the adapter makes no network calls and fetches no live market data itself

verdict.fail: any integrity check other than market.resolution reports FAIL
verdict.inconclusive: the market had not resolved when the evaluation ran (limitation: market-unresolved)
verdict.pass: every integrity check passes and the market resolved with an outcome

scoring.rule: brier = (probability - target)^2 with target 1 for YES and 0 for NO; spread = solverBrier - consensusBrier

evidence: the adapter currently returns no claimEvidence entries; the deployment's evidenceWriter is a real, durable content-addressed filesystem repository, so a future adapter revision that attaches claim evidence is served without a deployment change
